name: exists_data
summary: Substitute x = e^X and work at a large real X (written x below), with W = e^{εx/6}. Take m = 2^{o+1} ≈ e^{x/2}, r = 3^{e+1} ≈ e^{5x}, s = 22(o + 1), logX = x, logX₁ = W, logB = W⁶. A weak Siegel–Walfisz theorem gives primes ≡ 1 mod Mω(P, s)² in every window of length W in [W, W^n]; h_K + 1 such primes split in K, and the class-group pigeonhole gives two, g₀ ≠ g₁, with an integer α of K of norm g₀g₁. Behrend's construction in Φ ≅ (ℤ/N₁)^× gives the thick places. All size conditions are inequalities between powers of x, W and 2^n that hold for large x.

steps.claim: Fix a natural number n > max(99·N₀(P)·d(P)/(ε/6), 6).
steps.lean: have ⟨n, h⟩ := exists_nat_gt (99 * P.N₀ * P.d / (ε / 6) ⊔ 6)

steps.claim: For every natural k, exp((ε/6)·X)/X^k → ∞ as X → ∞ (ε/6 > 0 by e0).
steps.lean: have E (k : ℕ) := tendsto_exp_mul_div_rpow_atTop k _ e0

steps.claim: Hence for every natural k and real c, eventually exp((ε/6)·X)/X^k ≥ c.
steps.lean: have ev k c := E k (mem_atTop c)

steps.claim: Since exp maps atTop onto atTop, it suffices to prove, for all large real x, the statement at the point e^x: data D with x(D) = e^x, log x₁(D) = (e^x)^{ε/6}, (10⁶·log e^x)² ≤ log x₁(D), log log b(D) = ε·log e^x and towerDeg(s(D))/log b(D) ≤ #thick(D). From here on x is the logarithm of the scale.
steps.lean: rw [← map_exp_atTop, eventually_map]

steps.claim: For all large x at once, with W = e^{εx/6}: (hg) the prime-window statement of `exists_prime_modEq_one_log_mem` for the modulus N₀(P)·d(P) (divisible by 4) and the exponent n, at the point W: for every k > 1 with (N₀(P)·d(P))^k ≤ W^n and every U ∈ [W, W^n] there is a prime p ≡ 1 mod (N₀(P)·d(P))^k with U ≤ log p ≤ U + W; (h3) W/x² ≥ 10¹²; (hL) W/x^{n+1} ≥ (8019·N₀(P) + 2)·10368^n; (lx) x ≥ 1; (h5) W ≥ 2·h_K + 10⁶, h_K the class number of K; (x0) x > 0; x ≥ 2; (hf) W ≥ exp(10¹²·c(P)); (hC) W/x ≥ 8019·2^n·n.
steps.lean:
filter_upwards [E 0 (exists_prime_modEq_one_log_mem (P.N₀ * P.d) n (by grind [Parameters])),
    ev 2 1e12, ev (n + 1)
    ((P.N₀ * 8019 + 2) * 10368 ^ n), mem_atTop 1, ev 0 (2 * classNumber P.K + 1e6), Ioi_mem_atTop 0,
    mem_atTop 2, ev 0 (1e12 * P.c).exp, ev 1 (8019 * 2 ^ n * n)] with x hg h3 hL lx h5 x0 _ hf hC

steps.claim: Normalise these facts and the goal: real powers with natural exponents, denominators cleared, (e^x)^{ε/6} = e^{x·ε/6}.
steps.lean: simp_all [↓rpow_natCast, le_div_iff₀, div_lt_iff₀, ← exp_mul, mul_comm x]

steps.claim: (N) For reals X ≥ 1 and Y > 1 there is a natural number q with Y^q ≤ X < Y^{q+1}.
steps.lean: have N (x y : ℝ) (e : 1 ≤ x := by simp; bound) (h : 1 < y := by simp) := exists_nat_pow_near e h

steps.claim: From the choice of n: 99·N₀(P)·d(P) < n·ε/6 and 6 < n. Take o with 2^o ≤ e^{x/2} < 2^{o+1} (m1, m2) and e with 3^e ≤ e^{5x} < 3^{e+1} (r1, r2); m = 2^{o+1} and r = 3^{e+1} will be the ranks.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨h, n0⟩, ⟨o, m1, m2⟩, e, r1, r2⟩ := h, N (x / 2).exp 2, N (5 * x).exp 3

steps.claim: s8 : s ≤ 32x, since o·log 2 ≤ x/2 (from 2^o ≤ e^{x/2}), log 2 > 0.6931471803 and x ≥ 2.
steps.lean: have s8 : s ≤ 32 * x := by simp [s, pow_le_iff_le_log, exp_pos] at *; nlinarith [log_two_gt_d9]
have W0 := exp_pos (ε / 6 * x)

have ⟨k, k1, k2⟩ := N (2 ^ s / _) (2 ^ n) ((one_le_div W0).2 (by
    grw [pow_mul, ← le_self_pow₀, ← m2, e1] <;> bound)) (mod_cast by grind)

steps.claim: Name W = exp((ε/6)·x).
steps.lean: set W := exp (_ * x)

steps.claim: (Y) W^i ≤ W^j for natural numbers i ≤ j, since W ≥ 1.
steps.lean: have Y i j (h : i ≤ j := by lia) : W ^ i ≤ W ^ j := by bound

steps.claim: s6 : (N₀(P)·d(P))^{2(s+6)} ≤ W^n, by comparing logarithms: 2(s + 6)·log(N₀(P)·d(P)) ≤ 2(32x + 6)·N₀(P)·d(P) ≤ 99·N₀(P)·d(P)·x < n·(ε/6)·x = n·log W (log y ≤ y, s ≤ 32x, x ≥ 2).
steps.lean:
have s6 := @pow_le_of_le_log ((P.N₀ * P.d) ^ ((s + 6) * 2)) W n W0 (by
    grw [log_pow, log_exp, ← mul_assoc, ← h, log_le_self] <;> simp [field]; grind)

steps.claim: s5 : 2^s ≤ W^n, since 2^s ≤ (N₀(P)·d(P))^{2(s+6)} (N₀(P)·d(P) ≥ 2, as d(P) > 64) and s6.
steps.lean: have s5 : 2 ^ s ≤ W ^ n := s6.trans' (mod_cast by gcongr <;> nlinarith only [P.lt_d, pos P.N₀])

steps.claim: Apply hg with the exponent 2(s + 6) > 1 and s6: for every U ∈ [W, W^n] there is a prime p ≡ 1 mod (N₀(P)·d(P))^{2(s+6)} with log p ∈ [U, U + W]; and w2 : W² ≤ W⁶.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨hg, w2⟩ := hg _ (by lia) s6, Y 2 6

steps.claim: Rewrite (N₀(P)·d(P))^{(s+6)·2} = ((N₀(P)·d(P))^{s+6})² = Mω(P, s)² in hg, and k2 as 2^s < (2^n)^{k+1}·W.
steps.lean: simp [pow_mul, field] at hg k2

steps.claim: For every i ∈ {0, …, h_K} choose a prime p_i ≡ 1 mod Mω(P, s)² (hp, hm) with 10W⁶ + 2iW ≤ log p_i ≤ 10W⁶ + (2i + 1)W (l, u), together with i1 : 0 ≤ i·W ∧ 2(i + 1)·W ≤ W².
steps.lean:
choose i1 p hp hm l u using fun i : Fin (classNumber P.K + 1) ↦ have : 0 ≤ i * W ∧ (i + 1) * W * 2
    ≤ W ^ 2 := ⟨by bound, by grw [i.is_le]; nlinarith only [h5]⟩; And.intro this (hg (10 * W ^ 6
    + 2 * i * W) (by bound) (by nlinarith only [this, Y 7 n, w2, h5]))

steps.claim: 0 ≤ i·W and (i + 1)·W·2 ≤ W², since i ≤ h_K and W ≥ 2h_K + 10⁶ (h5).
steps.lean:
have : 0 ≤ i * W ∧ (i + 1) * W * 2
    ≤ W ^ 2 := ⟨by bound, by grw [i.is_le]; nlinarith only [h5]⟩;

steps.claim: The window start U = 10W⁶ + 2iW lies in [W, W^n] (U ≤ 10W⁶ + W² ≤ 11W⁶ ≤ W⁷ ≤ W^n as n ≥ 7, W ≥ 10⁶), so hg gives the prime p_i.
steps.lean:
And.intro this (hg (10 * W ^ 6
    + 2 * i * W) (by bound) (by nlinarith only [this, Y 7 n, w2, h5]))

steps.claim: hN : p_i ≡ 1 mod N₁(P, s)·d(P), because N₁(P, s)·d(P) divides Mω(P, s) and hence Mω(P, s)².
steps.lean: have hN i := (hm i).of_dvd (P.N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega.pow out)

steps.claim: For each i choose finite places I_i, J_i of K above p_i with q(I_i) = q(J_i) = p_i and (p_i) = I_i·J_i (nI, nJ, eJ): a place w of K above p_i has norm p_i, because chiK(d(P))(p_i) = 1 (p_i ≡ 1 mod N₁(P, s)·d(P), `chiK_eq_one_of_modEq_one`) and `q_eq_iff_legendreSym_ne_neg_one`; so the inert case of `prime_inert_or_eq_mul` (norm p_i²) is excluded and p_i splits as w·J.
steps.lean:
choose I J nI nJ eJ using fun i ↦ have := Fact.mk (hp i); (FinPlace.exists_natCast_mem P.K
      (p i)).imp fun w h ↦ (prime_inert_or_eq_mul w h).imp fun _ ↦
      (·.2.resolve_left (by simp [(q_eq_iff_legendreSym_ne_neg_one w h).2, sq,
      P.chiK_eq_one_of_modEq_one (hN i), (hp i).ne_one]))

steps.claim: Pigeonhole in the class group (`exists_mul_principal`, each I_i·J_i = (p_i) being principal): indices i ≠ j and α ∈ 𝓞_K with I_i·J_j = (α).
steps.lean: have ⟨i, j, ne, α, hα⟩ := exists_mul_principal (⟨_, eJ · |>.symm⟩)

steps.claim: Put M = N₀(P)·3^{⌊log₃ s⌋+5}.
steps.lean: let M := P.N₀ * 3 ^ (Nat.log 3 s + 5)

steps.claim: For every m′ and every proof of m′ ∣ N₁(P, s), the class of placeOfInt(P, s, M + 1) in (ℤ/m′)^× is M + 1 (`placeClass_placeOfInt`, as M + 1 ≡ 1 mod N₀(P) is prime to N₀(P)).
steps.lean: have := @Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt P s (M + 1) (mod_cast by simp [M])

steps.claim: Behrend's construction (`exists_three_term_free`) for φ = placeClass(P, h₂) : Φ(P, s) → (ℤ/2^{s+1})^× (h₂ = `two_pow_dvd_N₁`), c = placeOfInt(P, s, −1), g = placeOfInt(P, s, M + 1), dimension n, side 2^k and L = 324·s > 0 gives T ⊆ Φ(P, s) with every σ ∈ T of the form placeOfInt(P, s, −1)·placeOfInt(P, s, M + 1)^e (t1), #T ≥ (2^k)^n/(n·(2^k)²) (t2) and the three-term property for 0 < i < j ≤ 324s (t). Its hypothesis (324s·2^k)^n ≤ orderOf(φ(g)) follows by cancelling the positive factor (M + 1) + 1 from (M + 2)·(324s·2^k)^n ≤ 2^s ≤ (M + 2)·orderOf(φ(g)).
steps.lean:
have ⟨T, t1, t2, t⟩ := exists_three_term_free (P.placeClass P.two_pow_dvd_N₁) (P.placeOfInt s
    (-1)) (P.placeOfInt s (M + 1)) n (2 ^ k) (324 * s) (by lia) (le_of_mul_le_mul_left (.trans (by
    unfold M; norm_cast; grw [pow_add, Nat.pow_log_le_add_one]; rify
    grw [← (le_div_iff₀ W0).1 k1, lx, ← hL, s8, s8]; ring; rfl)
    (@two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one (M + 1) (mod_cast by
    simp) _ s (orderOf_pos _) (this ▸ Units.ext_iff.1 (pow_orderOf_eq_one _)))) (pos _))

(by
    unfold M; norm_cast; grw [pow_add, Nat.pow_log_le_add_one]; rify
    grw [← (le_div_iff₀ W0).1 k1, lx, ← hL, s8, s8]; ring; rfl)

steps.claim: 2^s ≤ (|M + 1| + 1)·orderOf(φ(g)): the class of g = placeOfInt(P, s, M + 1) modulo 2^{s+1} is M + 1 (24), |M + 1| > 1, and (M + 1)^{orderOf(φ g)} ≡ 1 mod 2^{s+1}; then `two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one`.
steps.lean:
(@two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one (M + 1) (mod_cast by
    simp) _ s (orderOf_pos _) (this ▸ Units.ext_iff.1 (pow_orderOf_eq_one _))))

steps.claim: The cancelled factor |M + 1| + 1 is positive.
steps.lean: (pos _))

steps.claim: Define the data: logX = x, logB = W⁶, logX₁ = W, the exponent s, m = 2^{o+1}, r = 3^{e+1}, s_le = s8, thick = T, g = (p_i, p_j), piG = α; m_pow (m = 2^{o+1}, s = 22(o + 1)) and r_pow (r = 3^{e+1}) hold by construction. The fields scale, m_mem, r_mem, g_prime, g_modEq_one, norm_piG, exists_prime_window and the five claimed properties are left as goals.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨⟨_, W ^ 6, W, s, _, _, s8, T, p ∘ ![i, j], α, ?_, ?_, ?_, ⟨o, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨e, rfl⟩,
    fun _ k ↦ (by cases t1 · ·; simp [*, P.placeClass_placeOfInt isCoprime_one_left.neg_left,
    Units.ext_iff, (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff M _).2 k]), t, ?_, ?_, fun _ ↦ (hm _).symm.dvd',
    (Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i ↦ by
    rify; grw [← log_lt_log_iff, u, ← l] <;> simp [(hp _).pos]; bound).injective.comp
    (by simpa), by
    simp [pow_le_iff_le_log, le_pow_iff_log_le, (hp _).pos, exp_pos]; grind, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [m2.le, r2.le, ← absNorm_span_eq_mul_star, ← hα, nI, nJ, hp, hN]

steps.claim: thick_eq_neg_one_mod: for m′ ∣ N₁(P, s) with m′ ∣ M and σ ∈ T, σ = placeOfInt(P, s, −1)·placeOfInt(P, s, M + 1)^e has class (−1)·(M + 1)^e = −1 in (ℤ/m′)^×, since M ≡ 0 mod m′ (`placeClass_placeOfInt` for −1, `ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff`).
steps.lean:
fun _ k ↦ (by cases t1 · ·; simp [*, P.placeClass_placeOfInt isCoprime_one_left.neg_left,
    Units.ext_iff, (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff M _).2 k]),

steps.claim: three_term is t (from 25); g_prime and g_modEq_one are left as goals; dvd_g_sub_one: Mω(P, s)² divides p − 1 for p = p_i, p_j, from p ≡ 1 mod Mω(P, s)².
steps.lean: t, ?_, ?_, fun _ ↦ (hm _).symm.dvd',

steps.claim: g_injective: i ↦ p_i is strictly increasing on {0, …, h_K} (log p_i ≤ 10W⁶ + (2i + 1)W < 10W⁶ + 2(i + 1)W ≤ log p_{i+1}), hence injective, and the pair (i, j) has i ≠ j.

(Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i ↦ by
    rify; grw [← log_lt_log_iff, u, ← l] <;> simp [(hp _).pos]; bound).injective.comp
    (by simpa),

steps.lean:
by
    simp [pow_le_iff_le_log, le_pow_iff_log_le, (hp _).pos, exp_pos]; grind,

?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [m2.le, r2.le, ← absNorm_span_eq_mul_star, ← hα, nI, nJ, hp, hN]

steps.claim: scale: with log logB = log W⁶ = εx and log logX₁ = log W = εx/6: 10¹²·c(P) ≤ εx (hf), 100·εx ≤ x (ε < 1/100), 10⁶·x ≤ W (h3, x ≥ 1), 10⁶·W ≤ W⁶ (w2, W ≥ 10⁶) and 6·(εx/6) ≤ εx.
steps.lean: simp [W]; and_intros <;> nlinarith only [e0, e1, w2, lx, h3, hf, h5]

steps.claim: The upper bounds of m_mem and r_mem: 2^{o+1} = 2·2^o ≤ 2e^{x/2} and 3^{e+1} = 3·3^e ≤ 3e^{5x} (m1, r1).
steps.lean: iterate 2 simpa [pow_succ']

steps.claim: exists_prime_window: since W ≤ √(W⁶) (from W² ≤ W⁶), it suffices, for every U with 100·W⁶ ≤ U ≤ 2^s, to find a prime p ≡ 1 mod Mω(P, s)² with log p ∈ [U, U + W].
steps.lean: grw [← le_sqrt_of_sq_le w2]; intros

steps.claim: That is hg, because W ≤ 100·W⁶ ≤ U ≤ 2^s ≤ W^n (s5).
steps.lean: apply hg <;> grind

steps.claim: The remaining properties apart from the last: (10⁶·x)² ≤ W = log x₁ (h3), and log log b = log(W⁶) = 6·(ε/6)·x = εx.
steps.lean: use by bound, by simp [W, field]

steps.claim: The last property towerDeg(s)/W⁶ ≤ #T: by t2 it suffices to bound towerDeg(s)/W⁶ by (2^k)^n/(n·(2^k)²); towerDeg(s) = 3^{⌊log₃ s⌋+5}·2^s ≤ 243·(s + 1)·2^s, 2^s < (2^n)^{k+1}·W (k2) and s ≤ 32x.
steps.lean:
grw [← t2, towerDeg, pow_add, Nat.pow_log_le_add_one]; simp; grw [k2, s8, pow_succ,
    pow_right_comm]

steps.claim: Clearing denominators, use 2^k < W — because (2^k)^n = (2^n)^k ≤ 2^s/W < W^n (k1, s5) — and x ≥ 1.
steps.lean: field; grw [(lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ n W0.le (by grw [← s5, pow_right_comm, k1]; bound) :), lx]

steps.claim: The resulting polynomial inequality follows from 8019·2^n·n·x ≤ W (hC) and W³ ≤ W⁵.
steps.lean: nlinarith only [hC, Y 3 5]
